# Veristrux Inc. — Complete Technical, MCP & Product Reference (`llms-full.txt`)

> Deterministic spatial verification for Unreal Engine 5.8/5.9, `<5 ms` zero-content-telemetry agent context & security guards, and GQA/MoE local silicon memory planners.

- **Organization:** Veristrux Inc. (Delaware Corporation, USA)
- **Canonical Domain:** https://veristrux.com/
- **Support & Studio Licensing:** mailto:argoness@veristrux.com
- **GitHub Organization / Engineering Lab:** https://github.com/argoness-prime
- **Merchants of Record:** Polar.sh (`https://buy.polar.sh/...`) and itch.io (`https://argoness-prime.itch.io`)
- **Privacy Invariant:** Zero-Content-Telemetry across all interactive browser labs, MIT CLI/MCP servers, and desktop utilities. Source code, prompts, UBT/Cook logs, `DefaultEngine.ini` files, and 3D meshes never leave the user's local machine.

## 1. Interactive Client-Side Browser Labs (`4 / 4` Live `HTTP 200`)

All four sandboxes execute 100% locally in the visitor's browser with zero signup, zero cookies, and zero backend uploads.

### 1.1 ViewDrift (`/ppd v1.5.0`) — Showcase & 4-Pillar Spatial Verification Walkthrough
- **URL:** https://veristrux.com/viewdrift-demo.html
- **Domain:** Unreal Engine 5.8 & 5.9 C++20 / RDG HLSL spatial verification & AI/MCP mutation guard.
- **Architectural Highlights:**
  - **6-Surface Optical Chamber (`A-NORTH` .. `F-CEILING`):** Equal-solid-angle **29-Prime** (`12` pentagons + `17` hexagons, `4pi/29 sr`) 6-wall optical reference frame shipped inside the proprietary UE 5.8/5.9 Render Dependency Graph (`RDG`) plugin.
  - **Projective-Radiometric Null-Space Drift (Modes I–III):**
    1. *Mode I (Viewing-Ray Depth Spikes):* Standard `0 deg` Lit captures hide `20 mm` vertex spikes aligned along the camera ray; oblique chamber walls and multi-azimuth parallax expose them immediately.
    2. *Mode II (Sub-Nyquist Seams & Folds):* Post-deformation 3D point-to-triangle gate (`<= 0.50 mm`) catches seams that can evade 2D RGB inspection.
    3. *Mode III (Radiometric Metamerism):* UE 5.9 `0.30` Detail Lighting override boosts orphaned `SSS=0` contrast by `8.9x` compared to `0 deg` Lit lighting, paired with an optional `64-SPP` relative Path-Tracer check.
  - **Stateful `SelectiveDirtyBit` (`b_mesh` / `b_uv`) MCP Save Firewall:** Separates geometry and material dirty state before `SavePackage`.

### 1.2 Token Czar v2.0 — `<3 ms` AST Symbol-Map & `165K` Prompt-Cache Sandbox
- **URL:** https://veristrux.com/tokenczar-demo.html
- **Domain:** Context-window hygiene and prompt-cache preservation for Claude Code, Google Antigravity, and Cursor.
- **Capabilities:**
  - Parses pasted Python, TypeScript, or Unreal Engine 5.9 C++ source files in `<3 ms` client-side.
  - Emits compact `Lstart-Lend` AST Symbol-Maps plus 80-line `[CHUNK]` breadcrumbs to enforce `<=350`-line `PreToolUse` read windowing instead of multi-thousand-line raw file dumps.
  - Models cumulative prompt-cache economics across multi-hour sessions: `165K` Warm Auto-Compactor + `240s` Cache Sleep Guard (`0.10x` warm cache read rate) versus unguarded `512K` context growth and `>5 min` TTL expiry cliffs (`1.25x` cold cache re-write penalty).
  - **Important Disclosure:** Token Czar and Iron Veil are local workflow middleware hooks — **not** a provider financial spend cap. Users should configure hard billing caps directly in their AI provider console.

### 1.3 UE5 Build, Crash-Log & VRAM Doctor — `<5 ms` Triage & OpenXR 90 Hz INI Lab
- **URL:** https://veristrux.com/ue5-doctor-demo.html
- **Domain:** Unreal Engine 5.4–5.9 C++ build failure isolation and GPU VRAM / OpenXR 90 Hz `DefaultEngine.ini` auditing.
- **Capabilities:**
  - **Tab 1 (`<5 ms` UBT / UAT / Cook Triage):** Deduplicates noisy UnrealBuildTool, UAT, and Cook logs down to the originating first-cause error (`LNK2019` unresolved symbols, `D3D12 Out of Video Memory` / Virtual Shadow Map page overflow, missing redirectors). Distinguishes symbols referenced in public `.h` headers (`PublicDependencyModuleNames`) vs `.cpp`-only compilation units (`PrivateDependencyModuleNames`) to generate minimal `<Module>.Build.cs` patches.
  - **Tab 2 (`8–32 GB` Desktop Deferred vs OpenXR 90 Hz INI Lab):** Audits `Config/DefaultEngine.ini` across `8 / 12 / 16 / 24 / 32 GB` GPUs while strictly separating **Desktop Deferred (`0.32` streaming pool ratio, `4096` VSM pages at `>=16 GB`)** from **OpenXR 90 Hz (`11.1 ms` stereo budget, `0.22` pool ratio -> `3604 MiB` on `16 GB`, `r.Shadow.Virtual.MaxPhysicalPages=2048`, `r.Lumen.Reflections.Allow=0`, `r.HairStrands.SkyLighting.IntegrationType=2`, `vr.InstancedStereo=True`)**.

### 1.4 Hybrid Silicon Tuner v1.1.0 — Exact GQA KV-Cache & Sparse MoE Split Lab
- **URL:** https://veristrux.com/silicon-tuner-demo.html
- **Domain:** Deterministic GPU GDDR + Host DDR5-6400 memory planning for local LLMs (`llama.cpp`, `Ollama`, `vLLM`).
- **Deterministic Byte Accounting (Zero Unmeasured `tok/s` Claims):**
  - **Exact GQA KV-Cache Element Formula:** `N_elem = 2 (K&V) * num_layers * num_kv_heads * head_dim * context_tokens`. For `Qwen3.6-35B-A3B` (`L=48, H_q=32, H_kv=4, d=128, ctx=32,768`), `N_elem = 1,610,612,736` elements:
    - Counterfactual 32-head MHA (`fp16`, `2.00 B/el`): `24.00 GiB`
    - 4-head GQA unquantized (`fp16`, `2.00 B/el`): `3.00 GiB`
    - 4-head GQA quantized (`q8_0`, `1.06 B/el`): `1.59 GiB` (`-93.38%` vs MHA `fp16`)
    - 4-head GQA quantized (`q4_0`, `0.56 B/el`): `0.84 GiB`
  - **Explicitly Separated GPU Ledgers (16 GiB Card + 64 GiB DDR5 Example):**
    - *Naive Full-GPU `-ngl 48` (`fp16` KV + `1.25 GiB` DWM):* `24.56 GiB` (`+8.56 GiB` CUDA/DX12 OOM)
    - *GPU Application Budget (`Physical - 1.25 GiB DWM`):* `14.64 / 14.75 GiB` (`3.16 GiB` Shared Attention/Router + `9.34 GiB` Hot GPU Experts `27/48` + `1.59 GiB` `q8_0` KV + `0.55 GiB` Compute Scratch)
    - *Physical GPU Card Ceiling (`w/ 1.25 GiB OS/DWM Reserve`):* `15.89 / 16.00 GiB` (`0.11 GiB` hard margin preventing DX12 shared-memory demotion)
    - *Host DDR5-6400 Cold-Expert Pool:* `7.26 / 60.00 GiB` (`21/48` cold expert FFN layers via `--n-cpu-moe 21`; `3.2B / 35.0B` = `1.81 GiB` active weights routed per token; `102.4 GB/s` theoretical peak for dual-channel 64-bit DDR5-6400 = `2 * 8 B * 6.4 GT/s`).

## 2. Official MCP Registry Servers (`3 / 3` Active on `registry.modelcontextprotocol.io`)

All three MIT open-core packages run with **zero third-party Python dependencies** (`Python >= 3.10` stdlib only) over `stdio` JSON-RPC 2.0.

### 2.1 `io.github.argoness-prime/iron-veil` (`v1.3.0`)
- **Repository:** https://github.com/argoness-prime/iron-veil
- **Registry Endpoint:** https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0.1/servers/io.github.argoness-prime%2Firon-veil/versions/latest
- **Glama Directory:** https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/argoness-prime/iron-veil
- **Quickstart:**
  ```bash
  claude mcp add iron-veil -- uvx --from https://github.com/argoness-prime/iron-veil/releases/download/v1.3.0/iron_veil_core-1.3.0-py3-none-any.whl iron-veil-core mcp
  npx skills add argoness-prime/iron-veil
  ```
- **Tools & CLI Commands:** `PreToolUse` secret airgap (`11/11` open-core selftest), Unicode/Bidi & hidden DOM prompt-injection sanitizer, `quarantine-repo` for third-party clones, `<=350`-line AST read guard, and `iron-veil-core xray` offline Claude Code transcript auditor.
